translation.name: Bab dummad Jesucristoba igar mesisad garda

book.name: 1 Juan
book.title: Juan Gwenadganse Gebe Garda Narmaksad 1 Juan

content: Bemar dakmalana, ibiyobi Bab anmar-sabgusa, adi anmar Bab-Dummad-mimmiganye soglemalagar. We-napneggi-bukmalad-Bab-Dummad-aku-dakmarsoggu, a-ular we-napneggi-bukmalad aku anmar-dakmarmosunnad.

Gwenadgan-sabemalad, anmar emigindi Bab-Dummad-mimmigan gumalad, amba anmar wichurmalad, igi an nue gudapmaloe. Ar an wisiddi an wismardo, Cristo anmarse na san-oyononikile, Cristoyob anmar gunonimogoed, ar ade anmar Cristo-dakleged-sunnad, an dakmaloed.
Ar bela dulemar-we-ibmar-Cristogi-bensuli-edarbedimalad na dukin san-swilidik imaked, ar igi Cristo na san-swilidik nikmoga.
Ar dule iskusale, igar-maidgi annasdo. Ar ade iskued, igar-maidgi-annaedid.
Ar bemar wisid, Cristo anmar-iskued-eliegala we-napnegse nonikid, degine, Cristogi-iskued gwen naisulid.
Ar dule-wargwen Cristogi akanaile, geg iskuedgi nanaed. Dule-wargwen iskuedgi nanaele, we-dule amba yo Cristo-dakdo, degine, amba aku Cristo-dakbarsundo.
Mimmigan, mer dule be-yardaked be imakmalo. Ar dule igar-napiragwad-saedi, we dule-gwage-nueddo, ar igi Cristo, dule-gwage-nuedmoga.
Dule iskuedgi-nanaed, we-a-dule nia-saila-sordado, ar ade nia-saila gusgu gebesailaunni iskudiguad. Ar a-ulale Bab-Dummad-Machi wese sanar-gunonikid, adi nia ibmarmar-saed obelogegar.
Ar dule-wargwen Bab Dummadgi burbar gwalulesale, geg iskuedgi-nanaed, ar ade Bab-Dummad-e-mimmiga-gued egi naid. Degisoggu, geg iskuedgi nanasundo, ar ade Bab Dummadgi bato gwalulesad.

Ar weyob-magar-daklenoni dasunnad, dule nia-saila-e-mimmi-dibe, igi, dule Bab-Dummad-mimmi-dibe. Ar dule-wargwen igar-maidba inikii ibmar imaksulile, degine, na e-gwenad-sabsulile, we Bab-Dummad-sordasulid.
Gwenadgan, na be muchub-muchub sabgumar
Ar we-gaya-burba gebesailaunni bemar itosmalad: Na anmar muchub-muchub sabgumarye.

Melle Caínyobi gumalo, ar adi nia-saila-sordasoggu, a-ular na e-urba-oburgwisad. ¿Ibiga e-urba-oburgwis be insae? Ar ade ibmar-iskana na imaksad, e-urbadi ibmar-inikii imaksasoggu, egi nobedba e-urba-oburgwissunnad.
An gwenadgan, we-napneggi-dulemar-bukwad istar be-dakmalar, geger be dake-wilubsurmalad.
Anmar wismalad, anmar burgwar gudii, dula gunonikid. ¿Ibiga anmar deyob wismar be insae? Ar anmar gwenadgan-sabmaladbar. Ar dule na e-gwenad-sabsulile, we-dule amba burgwar gudiid.
Ar dule-wargwen e-gwenad na istar dakele, we dule-gindakeddo. Ar bemar wismalad, dule-gindaked e-gwagegi burba-geg-bergued geg nika-gued.
Cristo e-san-burba anmar-ular na uksadba, an wismalad, ibi sabgued obarilege. Degisoggu, gwenadgan-ular anmar burgweye sogele, anmar burgwe-wilubmarmogad.
Ar dule-wargwen we-napneggi-ibmar-nikadi e-gwenad ibmar-sate dakele, degite ega uksulile, ¿igi Bab-Dummad-sabgued we-dule-gwagegi nai gusunnoe? Bab-Dummad-sabgued e-gwagegi naisuli.
Mimmigan, melle unnila gayaginbi be sogmalo, dulemar an sabye. Anmar ibmar-saedgi oyogoed, anmar napiragwad dulemar-sabed.
Bab-Dummad-walikaa be gudiile, dobee be itogosulid
Ar anmar dulemar-sabguele, agi an na wismardo, anmar napiragwadba gudiid, degine, anmar gwagegi Bab-Dummad-asabin gwen dobee itogosulid.
Anmar-gwagegi anmar wis nosye anmar itomalale, insamalo, Bab Dummad anmar-gwageba bur dummadid, degine, Bab Dummad bela ibmar wisid.
Degisoggu, gwenadgan-sabemalad, ar anmar gwagegi akar itosulile, anmar Bab-Dummad-asabin gwen dobee itogosurmalad.
Ar ibu anmar Bab Dummadse egichidele, anmarga Bab Dummad ukoed, ar ade anmar e-igar-mamaidba nanadiid, degine, ar anmar Bab-Dummad-asabin ibmar-nuegan imakdiid.
We, Bab-Dummad-igalad: E-Machi-Jesucristo-nuggi be bensuli-gumar, degine, bemar na muchub-muchub sabgumar, ar igi Cristo anmarga bato sogsa-gusadyob.
Ar dule Bab-Dummad-e-igar-maidba daele, Bab Dummadgi akanaid, degine, Bab Dummad a-dulegi akanaimogad. Ar Bab Dummad na E-Burba-Nued anmarga uksad-ular anmar wismarsunnad, Bab Dummad anmargi gudiid.
